properties.name: houtu.web.session.session-id-name
properties.description: Define the session id key name in the request header data.

properties.name: houtu.web.session.expire
properties.description: Specifies the duration (in seconds) for which the session remains valid before it expires.

properties.name: houtu.web.session.efficient-cache-sync-channel
properties.description: Efficient secondary cache cluster synchronization pub/sub channel name.

properties.name: houtu.web.session.login-url
properties.description: Session Expiration Login URL Address (Only applicable in web environments).

properties.name: houtu.web.session.redis.*
properties.description: Session Redis configuration, consistent with the Redis configuration introduced by Spring Boot.
